zh: 把单词拆成若干段连续相同的字母。不同段之间本来就不相邻相同，冲突只出现在段内部。
长度为 L 的段里有 floor(L/2) 对互不重叠的相邻位置，每对至少要改一个，所以至少要改 floor(L/2) 次；隔一个改一个、换成与两侧都不同的字母就能达到这个下界。
对每个单词从左到右找出每一段的长度 L，累加 floor(L/2)；每个单词的结果按输入顺序空格分隔输出。总字符可达 10^7，要用快速读入并逐字符扫描。
en: Split each word into maximal runs of equal letters. Different runs never form equal neighbours, so conflicts only happen inside a run.

A run of length L contains floor(L/2) disjoint pairs of adjacent positions, and each pair needs at least one change, so at least floor(L/2) changes are needed; changing every second letter to one that differs from both neighbours reaches this bound.

For each word, scan from left to right to find each run length L and add floor(L/2); print the result for every word in input order, space-separated. The total input can reach 10^7 characters, so read it quickly and scan character by character.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Split the word into maximal runs of the same character. A run of length L needs at least one replacement for every two characters, floor(L/2) in total; runs are independent of each other, so add the results.

## Proof of correctness

A run of L equal characters contains floor(L/2) disjoint pairs of adjacent positions, and each pair needs at least one position changed, so floor(L/2) is a lower bound. Replacing every second position while avoiding the characters on both sides reaches the bound; 26 letters are enough to choose from, and run boundaries do not introduce new conflicts. Adding over the runs gives the optimum.

## Full range and complexity

The full range of 100 words of 100000 characters each is kept, so the total can reach 10000000 characters. Total time O(S), extra algorithm space O(1); splitting the actual input into lines takes another O(S). The largest standard input is 10000104 bytes, under 32 MiB; the domain is not reduced because of the input budget.

## Independent verification

Small cases use a minimum-replacement DP over 26 letters; large cases are cross-checked with pairing of disjoint adjacent conflicts and closed-form expectations, and two real 100 x 100000 cases are in the official package.
